newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday September 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday September 9.

text.p: ROME, Sept 9 (Reuter) Following are some of the top headlines in Italy's leading newspapers.
*Vatican spokesman Joaquin Navarro-Valls says the pope is not suffering from serious health problems, but has had stomach infections.(La stampa)

*Prime minister Romano Prodi responds to criticisms from Cesare Romiti, President of auto maker company Fiat, saying he does not need the support of northern Italy's industrial complex to govern.(ALL)

*Managing director of troubled computer giant Olivetti Francesco Caio says his company will recieve no financial assistance from the government but will be looking for partners to move the company away from computers. (Repubblica,La Stampa)
Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.Rome bureau:++39 6 678 2501
